newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Promus started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Promus started as a buy.

text.p: -- Raymond James Financial said it initiated coverage of Promus Hotel Corp with a buy recommendation.
-- Further details were not immediately available.
-- Shares rose 5/8 to 32-1/8 in morning NYSE trade.

-- In a research note obtained later, analyst Harry Venezia said the buy recommendation for the hotel frachisor is based on "dominant market position, rapid EPS growth, strengthening cash flow and predictable diversified operating strategy."

-- "As a franchisor of three of the fastest-growing brands in the country, Promus will open more hotels than any competitor in the industry. Promus is buffered from potential oversupply and ideally positioned to benefit from new development -- providing a stable and predictable driver to 25 percent EPS growth through 1999," Venezia wrote.
-- Promus's hotel brands include: Hampton Inns, Embassy Suites, Homewood Suites and Hampton Inn & Suites.

-- "Promus presently trades at a 10 to 20 percent discount to its peer group, but beginning in 1997 free cash flow should swell (approaching $150 million through 1999) and provide a catalyst for an improving valuation," he added.

-- "This valuation improvement combined with 25 percent EPS growth should result in 30 percent-plus share price appreciation over the next 12 months. We establish a $43 price target at 25 times 1998's expected EPS of $1.72."
